trigger_and_stop_contract.trigger: Cycle 1 must have terminal RESEARCH_GO on both exact same-season and locked p100 surfaces, every slice and integrity gate must pass, and a future execution authorization must pin exact Cycle-1 result and manifest hashes before any materialization or fit.
ineligible_if: Cycle 1 exact same-season gate is RESEARCH_NO_GO
Cycle 1 has an unevaluated required slice or gate
Cycle 1 has a hash, chronology, key, or leakage failure
Cycle 1 result or manifest hashes are unavailable
trigger_and_stop_contract.terminal_policy: After one authorized execution, stop P2 research regardless of pass or fail. A pass is only a local submission-worthiness finding; candidate creation and submission remain separate explicit actions.

hypothesis: The Cycle-1 trajectory signal is incremental rather than a standalone post-processing artifact if an identical raw-Celsius, hierarchically group-balanced meta learner with populated trajectory channels beats the same learner with those slots neutralized, under equal search budget and on both exact same-season and locked p100 transport surfaces.

immutable_aggregate_inputs.role: aggregate maturity-bias and exact comparator evidence

predecessor_contracts.sha256_policy: Re-verify this exact design SHA-256 in the future execution authorization; no design field may be edited to match results.

data_features_target_firewall.allowed_data: Historical labeled P2 training rows, frozen local prediction keys, and public-layer historical covariates only, after a future authorization pins their existing hashes.
data_features_target_firewall.common_base_feature_contract: The exact qualifying anchor prediction plus the same public-only normalized-curvature-residual feature set; if NCR did not qualify, its public-only feature construction may be reused but no failed prediction is used as anchor.
data_features_target_firewall.control_trajectory_slots: prediction=anchor, disagreement=0, distance=0, coverage=0, spread=0, slope=0
data_features_target_firewall.challenger_trajectory_slots: Populate all six slots from the single Cycle-1 cell locked before exact evaluation.
data_features_target_firewall.target: raw degrees-Celsius residual truth_temperature minus frozen_anchor_temperature

hierarchical_group_balance.weight_rule: Assign total weight 1/3 to each target layer; within a layer assign equal total weight to every nonempty fixed historical window; within a layer-window assign equal total weight to every nonempty KST day; within a layer-window-day divide weight equally across finite rows; normalize all final row weights to arithmetic mean 1.

leakage_safe_splits.inner_meta_selection: Three leave-one-fixed-window-out folds over the Cycle-1 March, May, and July pseudo-gaps. For each fold, train on two windows and validate on the third; all trajectory features retain Cycle-1 seven-day source separation.
leakage_safe_splits.selection_rule: Each arm selects one hyperparameter cell using leave-one-window-out layer-equal raw-Celsius RMSE only. Exact same-season and p100 labels are used once for terminal evaluation, never selection.

sealed_matched_search.cell_selection: Minimize equal-weight mean leave-one-window-out layer RMSE; ties resolve by lower worst-window RMSE, then fewer trees, then lexical cell id.

prediction_and_projection.control_finalist: Inner-selected best of frozen anchor cell zero and the eight retuned control cells.
prediction_and_projection.challenger_finalist: Inner-selected best of fixed Cycle-1 trajectory cell zero and the eight retuned challenger cells.
prediction_and_projection.projection: Use the byte-identical fixed public-endpoint monotone projection from Cycle 1 for both arms.
prediction_and_projection.weak_trajectory_support: Challenger trajectory slots are set to their registered neutral values; no alternative model or imputation is selected.

fair_incumbent_control.control_arm: Common 55 public-only slots plus six neutral trajectory slots.
fair_incumbent_control.challenger_arm: The same 61 ordered slots with the six Cycle-1 trajectory channels populated.

evaluation.primary_metric: row-pooled RMSE in raw degrees Celsius
secondary_metrics: weekly RMSE deltas and p90 regression
fold, layer, season, distance, missingness, coverage, and support slices
finite-value, feature-order, and exact key-alignment checks

SUBMISSION_GO.note: Research-only decision label; no candidate or official action is authorized.

P3_deprioritization.reason: The observed P3 headroom cannot supply the requested 2-3 points. P2 matched-budget incremental validation therefore receives priority while the separately frozen P3 ERA5 experiment remains untouched.

limitations: The three fixed meta-training windows provide limited regime diversity and can underrepresent rare hydrographic transitions.
Neutralized trajectory slots equalize feature count but do not make the information content of the two arms identical; that difference is the tested structure.
The exact same-season and locked p100 surfaces remain historical transport proxies rather than an official hidden holdout.
The fixed eight-cell budget may not match every historical incumbent tuning iteration, although both arms receive exactly the same new budget.
The inferred leaderboard point mapping is approximate and cannot guarantee official gain.
This final cycle terminates the P2 research branch regardless of outcome.
